gen-gf-grandstander-gf-radio-canada-big: Brash, bouncy Grandstander holds its letters open with short ascenders and a tall x-height, then hands off to Radio Canada Big. That sans-serif body stays simple and monoline, letting the heading do the shouting.
gen-satoshi-fs-erode: Erode is a serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Satoshi leads with the steadiness of a technical pen, and the gentle ebb and flow in Erode's weight gives that firmness some warmth.
gen-silkscreen-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Retro and lo-fi, Silkscreen spaces every letter out. Be Vietnam Pro, a sans-serif with a mean line set high and curve endings kept apart, stands taller than the heading's lowercase.
gen-silkscreen-fs-epilogue: Lo-fi and retro, Silkscreen leaves space around every letter, like spaghetti laid out in type, before Epilogue takes over. Its sans letters are curvy and unclamped, with a tall-bodied lowercase.
gen-silkscreen-fs-fira-sans: Clean and professional, the body text opens its s curves wide and runs a larger-than-usual x-height. Fira Sans has no stroke contrast at all, a quiet echo of Silkscreen's spaghetti-like lines.
gen-silkscreen-fs-merriweather-sans: Words look sturdy and large in Merriweather Sans, thanks to its tall lowercase, plus an e that opens clearly to the right. Silkscreen keeps to identical bars and a moderate lowercase height.
gen-silkscreen-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad open counters on its c and s. And reading it feels trustworthy and unhurried, while Silkscreen supplies the lo-fi, retro flavor.
gen-silkscreen-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic keeps its stroke ends far apart and has no thick-thin variation in any letter. Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, while Silkscreen is best at spaced-out, lo-fi display.
gen-gf-offside-gf-yaldevi: Curves that refuse to close give Offside its restless, widely tracked look. The heading commands attention, while Yaldevi, a sans-serif with outsized lowercase and a clearly open e, handles the reading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-tiktok-sans: Commanding and expressive, Paprika scatters its letters at a distance. It does loud display best, while TikTok Sans, a modern sans with a spacious c and tall x-height, does the steady reading.
